usedFor: Hostfully holds vacation rental bookings, and HubSpot receives each one as a deal from “New Booking” through “Create Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Booking” in Hostfully, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Each new booking opens a deal, so revenue from a stay is tracked in HubSpot.

watchOut: Pair “Updated Booking” with “Update Contact”, not “Create Deal”, or a changed stay opens a second deal.
